description: This is a test class for acceptance testing of the Invoices module in a SuiteCRM project. It uses the Codeception framework with various steps to test viewing, creating, and editing invoices, including handling of number rounding.

classes.name: InvoicesCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Invoices module, testing viewing, creation, and number rounding functionalities.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method invoked before each test to initialize fake data generator and seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewInvoicesModule
methods.description: Test to verify the invoices module view page loads correctly.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateInvoice
methods.description: Test to create a new invoice entry.

methods.name: testScenarioInvoiceRounding
methods.description: Test to create an invoice and verify number rounding in total fields.
